title: Account Settings
description: A complete settings surface with a section rail, labeled profile and workspace fields, notification switches and a danger zone.
summary: A settings rail, real form anatomy and a calm danger zone.
notes: Saving, uploading and deleting are illustrative actions. Connect the forms and buttons to your application handlers.
The section rail is in-page navigation; it does not load separate routes.
The switch rows use native checked state. Keep aria-checked in sync if you adopt role="switch" with application code.
